This gravy is pouring onto a plate piled so high it's about to spill over.
About an hour later, almost everyone at the table can barely keep their eyes open.
Most people blame the turkey. It has a chemical called tryptophan, which your body uses to make sleep chemicals.
But chicken has about the same amount, and pork has even more.
And in a big meal, tryptophan has to fight a crowd of other proteins just to reach your brain.
The real reason is the giant pile of food. Your body throws its energy into breaking it all down.
Add a few drinks and a short night of sleep, and your brain shuts down right there on the couch.
Follow for more, because this is why you get so sleepy after Thanksgiving dinner.
